                                          BUILDINGS BULLETIN 2011-007

        Supersedes:           None

               Issuer:        Alan Price, P.E.
                              Director, Office of Technical Certification and Research

     Issuance Date:           April 8, 2011

            Purpose:          This document establishes additional acceptance criteria for commercial dishwashers with
                              integral gas-fired heating in accordance with the 2008 NYC Construction Codes.

           Related            AC     113.2.3             PC    604.1            PC       802.1.7
       Code/Zoning            PC     409                 PC    604.3           FGC       402
        Section(s):

          Subject(s):         Commercial dishwasher, integral heating. Dishwasher, commercial


                                                                                                                  1
      Background:         Section PC 409 requires commercial dishwashers to conform to ASSE 1004 , which
                                                                                         2
                          establishes backflow prevention requirements and NSF 3 which establishes minimum
                          sanitary requirements. This bulletin addresses the safety performance of gas-fired commercial
                          dishwashers.

       Description:       A commercial dishwasher with integral gas-fired heating is used to boost water temperatures
                          during wash and rinse cycles. It is comprised of a self contained gas-fired hot water heater
                          with standard dishwasher component.

                Uses:     Commercial dishwashers with integral gas fired heating are used to wash and sanitize pans, pots,
                          racks and other utensils that are used in eating and drinking establishments.

Evaluation Scope:         2008 NYC Construction Codes

          Evaluation      Pursuant to section AC 28-113, the Office of Technical Certification and Research recognizes
            Criteria:     commercial dishwashers with integral gas-fired heating tested, and evaluated in accordance with
                                3
                          UL 921 and NYC Construction Codes including ASSE 1004 and NSF 3. Acceptable commercial
                          dishwashers with integral gas-fired heating shall be listed and labeled in accordance with section
                          AC 113.2.3 and shall comply with the conditions of this bulletin.

      Conditions of       Commercial dishwashers with integral gas-fired heating shall be designed, and installed in
       Acceptance:        accordance with the 2008 NYC Construction Codes and other applicable provisions including but
                          not limited to the following:

                          A. Design
                          1. Commercial dishwashers with integral gas-fired heating shall be specified in accordance
                          with the manufacturer’s recommendation and the condition of the listing.

                          B. Installation Requirements
                          1. Installation requirements shall be in accordance with the manufacturer’s instructions, the
                             applicable listing agency, and the conditions of this bulletin.
                          2. Installation shall be performed by a licensed master plumber only.
                          3. Combustion air and ventilation shall be in accordance with applicable sections of the NYC
                             Construction Codes, manufacturer’s installation and the listing.
                          4. Commercial dishwashers with integral gas-fired heating shall be labeled as per section
                             AC-113.4. All shipment and deliveries of materials shall be accompanied by a label
                             certifying the material shipped or delivered are equivalent to those tested and approved.

         Referenced 1. ASSE 1004-90 – “Performance Requirement for Backflow Prevention Requirement for
          Standard:    Commercial Dishwashing Machine”
                    2. NSF3 – 1996a “Commercial Spray-Type Dishwashing and Glass Washing Machines”
                    3. UL 921-06 – “Commercial Dishwasher”
